title: Strategist dossier — open-project warrant snapshot (propose-only); v0.2 carries the Context Digest by reference
description: The Strategist's project-level document: warrant assessment + harvestable context-digest + proposed goal sketches. It is NOT an atom (no atom_ id, no meaning.source_text), NOT a committed-design (no cd_), NOT a write into ontology/goals.json. Status is proposed until a human validates via tools/dossier_accept.py --by; the seat never sets validated. Species-closed lists (status, door, warrant verdicts/outcomes, finding, escape_kind) live here as dossier.v0.2 — version-bump to extend; do not silently extend goal draft/example/validated, beats proposed/accepted, or committed-design enums. Accepting this document promotes the dossier only; writing proposed_goals into the live goals store is a later hop. Canonical instances will live per-project; this schema is shared core. Example fixture stays proposed — not a live validated engagement. v0.2 (2026-09-02, studio-and-ledger): the digest DOCUMENT is saved whole beside the dossier and referenced from context_digest.document (path + sha256); the context_digest fields are VERBATIM EXCERPTS of that document (the gate checks substring identity — a harvester extracts, it never rewrites); three sections the ingestion prompt produces gained fields (concepts, assumptions, signal_noise); and the ARGUED half (warrant, outcomes, roi, finding, modality_recommendations, design_insights) is required only once status is validated — a digest-only dossier may exist as proposed, and dossier_accept.py refuses it until the argument has been had. Nothing about who may validate changed.

schema_version.description: Closed with this schema. v0.2 = context_digest by reference + verbatim excerpts + argued half required at validated. A new status, door, verdict, outcome, finding, or escape kind is a version bump, not a silent extend.

dossier_id.description: Opaque id of this dossier. Never atom_, never ele_, never cd_, never goal_, never obj_. Minted once; never reused, never edited.

status.description: v0.1 closed list for THIS species. proposed = Strategist (or a human) has drafted the warrant snapshot; validated = a human has ratified the assessment. Reuses the house words without extending goal.schema or committed-design enums. The agent never writes validated.

reviewer.description: Who validated. Required when status is validated; forbidden while proposed. A human handle, never an agent id.

client.description: Client namespace slug (e.g. brunswick). Not a person.

project.description: Project slug. The live dossier would live under that project; this schema's example is not a live client dossier.

proposed_by.description: Provenance of the proposal (e.g. strategist, a chat, a human handle). Not a ratification.

door.description: v0.1 closed list. open_project = Strategist warrant first. direct_escape = this pile is actually one bounded SOP-course; take Headwater Direct without pretending a warrant was found.

outcomes.description: Business outcomes in scope for this assessment. May be empty on a no-course terminal or a Direct escape. Not a write into ontology/goals.json.

proposed_goals.description: Optional goal_ payload sketches (label/measure/reachability). Not minted into ontology/goals.json this hop. Empty when the finding is no_course / not_this_course / direct_escape — do not mint a decorative goal_ to save a project. Never carry status validated.

audiences.description: Affected populations as SEGMENTS, never persons. No PII.

constraints.description: Project realities that bound the intervention: time, systems, access, regulation-as-lived.

risks.description: Failure modes, including false confidence from training.

politics.description: Organizational / political sensitivities. Segments and functions, never named persons.

modality_recommendations.description: Non-binding modality notes (course / not a course / job aid / communication / process). Not a production script.

roi.description: Intervention assessed in ROI terms: attention and cost against the trainable slice. Distinct from goal.measure (business discharge test) and from warrant Q1 (human-level case). Do not collapse the three.

finding.description: v0.1 closed list. Unreachable-LO terminal is no_course or not_this_course. Direct escape is recorded as itself, not as a held warrant.

design_insights.description: Harvestable close — DESIGN INSIGHTS FOR NORMALIZATION. Valuable ideas, implied chunks, where schemas will struggle, questions Jake should answer next. Standing mode is still dialogue; this field is the snapshot's carry.

_note.description: Free-text note about this document as a whole — example marker, provenance. House style (goal.schema.json). Never a corpus dump.

derived_from.description: The corpus this dossier is derived from. Store path + notes. Never the blobs, never meaning.source_text, never PII.

source_store.description: Store-relative pointer to the corpus home, never the file bytes.

notes.description: How this snapshot relates to the corpus. Not a dump.

direct_escape.description: This pile is actually one bounded SOP-course. Takes the Direct door without pretending a warrant was found. recorded_by is forbidden while proposed; accept stamps it from --by when promoting.

escape_kind.description: v0.1 closed list. sop_course = one bounded SOP/form; the document is the syllabus. Version-bump to extend.

rationale.description: Why this corpus is one bounded SOP-course, not an open-project warrant.

recorded_by.description: Human who recorded the escape at accept time. Forbidden while proposed. Agent never writes this.

context_digest.description: Harvestable ingest slice, v0.2. The digest DOCUMENT is the meaning — saved whole, referenced by `document`; these fields are its INDEX: verbatim excerpts, one or many per section, never a rewrite. A live dossier must carry `document` (the gate enforces it; the EXAMPLE fixture may omit it). Diagnostic observations are gaps without prescriptions.

document.description: The Context Digest saved whole. path is relative to the dossier file; sha256 is of the UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF (autocrlf-safe). The document is the one embedded payload; this JSON indexes it.

generated_by.description: Provenance of the document: which prompt, which kind of session. Not a ratification, not a person.

overview.description: Project overview, reconstructed (ingestion prompt §1). Verbatim excerpt(s) of the document — the gate checks each string is a substring (whitespace-normalized). Select; never paraphrase.

stated_vs_implied.description: Stated objectives vs implied objectives. Facts vs interpretations named (§2). Verbatim excerpt(s) of the document — the gate checks each string is a substring (whitespace-normalized). Select; never paraphrase.

concepts.description: Key concepts & definitions, canonicalized (§3). Verbatim excerpt(s) of the document — the gate checks each string is a substring (whitespace-normalized). Select; never paraphrase.

operational_reality.description: What people actually do — roles, handoffs, decision points. Internal operations brief, not a syllabus (§4). Verbatim excerpt(s) of the document — the gate checks each string is a substring (whitespace-normalized). Select; never paraphrase.

assumptions.description: Explicit and implicit assumptions (§5). Verbatim excerpt(s) of the document — the gate checks each string is a substring (whitespace-normalized). Select; never paraphrase.

signal_noise.description: Signal vs noise assessment, including content holes (§6). Verbatim excerpt(s) of the document — the gate checks each string is a substring (whitespace-normalized). Select; never paraphrase.

tensions.description: Contradictions, misalignment, training used to compensate for structural issues (§7). Verbatim excerpt(s) of the document — the gate checks each string is a substring (whitespace-normalized). Select; never paraphrase.

diagnostic_observations.description: Capability / knowledge / mindset / decision-making gaps. NO prescriptions in this field (§8). Verbatim excerpt(s) of the document — the gate checks each string is a substring (whitespace-normalized). Select; never paraphrase.

open_questions.description: Questions that expose hidden assumptions (§9). Verbatim excerpt(s) of the document — the gate checks each string is a substring (whitespace-normalized). Select; never paraphrase.

verdict.description: v0.1 closed vocab for one warrant question.

human_case.description: Q1 only — honest human-level case, not the business case as stated. Regulation is crystallized memory of a human cost.

trust_repair.description: Q3 only — true when Q1+Q2 pass and soil is poisoned; design mode, not a full fail.

warrant.description: The three questions. Documented either way. Designer's shield: the system requires a warrant.

outcome.description: v0.1 closed list. full_pass = all three affirmative; partial_pass = modified scope (including Q3-fail + Q1+Q2-pass as trust-repair); full_fail = two or more fails, do not deploy.
A business outcome in designer terms. measure is the discharge test. Not a minted goal_.

measure.description: Business discharge test — how anyone would know it moved. Distinct from warrant Q1 human_case.

proposed_goal.description: A sketch of a goal_ payload. Does not write ontology/goals.json. Must not carry status validated. goal.schema enums are not extended — there is no status field here on purpose.

goal_id.description: Proposed id. Not minted this hop.

measure.description: Business discharge test (goal.schema measure). Not the human-level case.

trainable.description: The part training can move. If nothing here is true, omit this sketch and set finding to no_course / not_this_course.

assessed_by.description: Who made the split. A role or function, not a person-name field.

audience_segment.description: A population, not a person. No name/email/PII fields exist on this object.

segment_id.description: Segment slug. Not a person. Not a record_id from the audience-model store (Audience Agent owns that hop).

label.description: Who this population is, as a role/tier/segment — never a person's name.

notes.description: Constraints, prior exposure, working conditions. Still not a person.
